craft_notes: Sthāyin: knot-yet-knower; world worn shrunken. Sanskrit-first: granthi (KNOT — binds, kept); saṃkucita-viśva (SHRUNK world — kept; viśvasiddhi triple-process per UNC, siddhi≠powers). Rows: 1 (‘shrunk to fit’ closes — contraction worn last), 10 (wearing-image left standing, no gloss). Close: ‘wearing a world shrunk to fit’. Rupture: em-dash (knot stated, then its wearing). Rejected: ‘lump’ — killed: knot binds; powers-reading — killed by UNC (NOTE holds standard). Read aloud: A-knot OF-know-ing, YET a-KNOW-er — … WEAR-ing A-world SHRUNK to FIT.

lines: A knot of knowing, yet a knower —
wearing a world shrunk to fit.

reads_against.argmap: How does free consciousness become the bound knower? → Cause stated, means refused, manifold explained, veil named: descent promised.
c1_essence: Free consciousness causes, unborrowing opens, divides by fitness, veils by tightening — descent promised.
